property_summary: With two recipients, P's transfer calls transferFrom on both and returns true; M's transfer only calls transferFrom on the first, but still returns true, so a third-party observer who checks whether the second transferFrom happened (e.g. via a mock that records calls) sees that P records two calls and M records only one.
change_summary: Replace the loop with a single call to the first element, removing iteration, but still return true on success.
